title: Tandem look gallery index
description: index.json at the root of the gallery: every look Tandem can browse and install. Written by scripts/gallery.py index; read by Tandem (data/LookGallery.kt), which leaves out any entry that doesn't fit.

version.description: Tandem refuses an index with a version newer than it knows.

id.description: The look's folder in looks/, and its link: tandem://look?id=<id>.

version.description: The look.json version of its file; Tandem marks newer ones as needing an update.

preview.description: Its preview picture, in its own folder; at most 1 MB and 2048 pixels a side.

file.description: Its .tandem file, in its own folder.

sha256.description: Of the .tandem file. Tandem checks it before installing.

size.description: Of the .tandem file, in bytes; at most 24 MB.
